//: offline-bundle MCP manifest. Fill in, then: python scripts/pack.py mcp --manifest <this-file> [--bundle <dir>]
//transports: http = server already running on the intranet (e.g. NocoDB built-in MCP) - only a zcode config fragment is generated, nothing is downloaded; stdio-npm = standalone npm MCP server - packed as a self-contained node_modules tree under bundle/mcp/<name>/
//secrets: any value may embed ask:VAR_NAME placeholders (also inside urls); they are prompted at intranet install time by _merge_mcp.py and never stored in the bundle
//bin: stdio-npm only: which entry of the package's bin map to expose, when it has several (e.g. nocodb-mcp vs nocodb-mcp-http). Defaults to the bin key matching the package name

servers.//: NocoDB built-in MCP (needs NocoDB >= 0.265.0; account-wide tokens need 2026.09.1+). Create the MCP token in the NocoDB GUI; the token id goes in the url path
servers.name: nocodb
servers.note: token: NocoDB GUI -> Base/Account settings -> MCP

servers.//: community stdio server (zoyak-tech/nocodb-mcp, NocoDB v3 API >= 2026.04; Community self-hosted gets ~40-50 of 92 tools - v3 meta API is partly Enterprise-gated)
servers.name: nocodb-mcp
servers.note: API token: NocoDB GUI -> Account -> Tokens
